messages:
yvonne: FYI I saw a recurring micro-regression on host parse path tied to grpc small writes. p99 up ~30ms over last 3 hours during traffic spikes. stack samples attached: https://perf.internal/stack/4322105555

infra-bot: perf-alert: host-parse.p99 +31ms window=3h

pat: we recently changed the streaming chunker to emit smaller frames when under memory pressure to avoid large ephemeral buffers. could that be triggering more writev calls?

yvonne: yes, chunker now slices at 512B by default under pressure; previously it would prefer 2KB frames. more frames -> more writev. we need a strategy to coalesce small frames at the host boundary before hitting gRPC.

drew: propose a simple host-side coalescer in the proxy path that batches writev calls within a 200us window or until combined size > 1KB. naive implementation reduced writev syscalls by ~70% in local sim. pseudo:
```
coalesce_buffer = []
start = now()
for frame in outgoing_frames:
  coalesce_buffer.append(frame)
  if total_size(coalesce_buffer) > 1024 or now()-start > 200us:
    grpc_writev(coalesce_buffer)
    coalesce_buffer.clear()
    start = now()
```

pat: sounds promising. does it add tail latency for small low-traffic requests? 200us isn't huge but we should allow a config knob per route.

yvonne: can we put an opt-in feature-flag and enable only for high-rate backends? also measure impact on client-observed latency.

drew: wrote a CL with feature-flag `ingress.coalesce_writev_ms=0.2` default disabled. CL also emits metric: grpc_small_write_count and writev_coalesce_ratio.

deploy-bot: rolling CL to canary: ingress.coalesce_writev_ms=0.2 on host-proxy-canary at 05:40 UTC

yvonne: early telemetry looks good: p99 down 18ms on canary, small_write_count down 64%. tail latency unchanged for low-traffic clients within noise.

pat: also let's add a fallback to disable coalescer when memory pressure is high to avoid adding buffering. put a short-circuit check: if mem_pressure>0.8 skip coalesce and flush immediately.

drew: added mem pressure short-circuit and updated CL. will run a short soak.

infra-bot: note: new metric grpc_writev_coalesced_rate emitted. creating dashboard.

yvonne: next steps:
- soak canary for 24h and validate no regression on low QPS routes (yvonne)
- tune default coalesce window (drew)
- make coalesce knob per-route and per-backend (pat)
drew: thanks folks. will post soak results and memory-pressure tests here.
